@Generated public final class InstanceGetOrCreateBotRequest extends com.google.protobuf.GeneratedMessage implements InstanceGetOrCreateBotRequestOrBuilder
Finds a configured account by its SDK name or Minecraft username.
Offline accounts need no authentication payload. A new Microsoft account
requires the account returned by the device-code authentication flow.
